description: This Java class is a Spring MVC Controller named MatriculaController handling HTTP requests related to course enrollments (matricula). It provides a method to create a new enrollment for a course based on course ID, and populates the model with course and user information upon success.

classes.name: MatriculaController
classes.description: A Spring MVC Controller managing course enrollment actions, secured with role-based access and mapping requests to relevant service methods and views.

methods.name: saveMatricula
methods.description: Handles GET requests to enroll a user in a course given the course ID, utilizing service and repository classes to create enrollment and populate the model for response.
